page.overview:
What is BrickHeadz?

BrickHeadz is a LEGO theme featuring buildable, collectable, and chibi characters made out of LEGO bricks, similar to Funko's "POP!" series of collectables. The theme released in 2016 and was first shown off at 2016 San Diego Comic Con. LEGO confirmed that the SDCC 2016 exclusive characters would be in 2 packs, while the 2017 BrickHeadz sets were released individually.
